todo.design: Order (author 2026-10-20: 'each piece should be explained in detail in the order the chain reads them and the scripts that call on them should be dissected too'): the Decoder follows a traced run of run_sample.py, not a reading of the code: the one command; Stage 0 (10 steps); Stage 1; Stage A; Stage M (Met-A); Stage MC (C-Score); Stage T (tare); IAM-Atlas v2.1 (79 cells, 813,951 sites, its tables and how they are read); IAM-Deconvolver (Stage D21); the skies; IAM-A (Q0, Q, QT, Q2); serial mode (12b); development readings; the report. Within each stage: the calling script, then each function in call order, then every data file it opens. Behind each reference, the builder that made it (atlas fit, blood composition markers, neutrophil reference, floors and identity sites, IAM-A position), what it was built from and what it was tested on. Inventory as of 2026-10-20: the one command loads 21 Python files, 228 functions, and 35 data and matrix files sit in the chain folder (chain/chain_inventory_2026-10-20.txt). Names (found 2026-10-20 tracing Met-A's 0.330): the chain's code and runtime matrices still call Met-A's healthy MIDDLE reference a 'floor' (metA_floors_v1_3.json, stage_m_met_a.py 'Met-A = mean H(beta) / floor', constant Met_A_floor_*), while the canon (foundation gauge_three_marks) defines the floor as H_min, thermal kicks against one ATP (2.5e-8 bits; 8e-8 on Met-A) and the middle as MEASURED on purified healthy cells (0.330263 bits). The Decoder uses the canon's names; the code's docstrings and printed text are renamed to 'healthy reference' with the file names kept and explained (the canon's planned SOP rename). Each step also carries one line: standard method used elsewhere, or from IAM's physics with its derivation and the test that could have failed (the ends of the gauge are bounds; the holding energy and the firm rate are the predictions that can fail). The middles: Met-A's is measured once on purified healthy cells of the same type; IAM-A's is computed from the sample's own loose ending (eps_pred(L) = firm rate + slope x L at the sample's own loose share; the line's form follows from the cell's design, its two constants measured once on 56 healthy cell types), so the sample is its own reference (author correction 2026-10-20). Code names (author 2026-10-20: 'things in the code that have the wrong names ... We dont want a researcher finding that'): the canon's retired and replaced terms are scanned in the chain's code too (comments, docstrings, every printed or report string), by a push check, so no wrong name can be pushed; the middle reference called 'floor' is the first.
